description: Anonymous Store API reads a browser on any origin may call (CORS). The server (src/browser_reads.rs) admits exactly these method/path templates, only without credentials, cart or buyer tokens and cookies, and only with the request headers listed here. The handbook's Try-it panels (scripts/api_reference.py) execute exactly these operations; every entry must exist in contracts/http as a public route. MCP is not listed: POST /mcp keeps its own origin policy.
